_como_editar: Catálogo generado desde la fuente: no lo edites para agregar consejos (eso va en items_guia.json). Sí puedes corregir un dato tras un parche. 'filtros' son las etiquetas de la tienda del juego. 'i' es la posición en img/items_all.webp.

items.texto_en:
Use a Consumable: Gain 10 Dampening for 8s.
• Open inventory slot: Gain a Multi Potion once every 45s
items.descripcion_es: Te da pociones gratis y reduces daño al usar consumibles.

items.texto_en:
On Use: Create a Healing Mushroom (6.4m radius) for 4.5s.
• +3% Health Heal every 1.5s
• +1 Stack of Damage Reduction per Heal
• 10% Attack and Ability Damage Reduction per Stack
• 5% Ultimate Damage Reduction per Stack
• All Stacks removed after triggering
Cooldown: 60s
items.descripcion_es: Activo: hongo que cura a tu equipo y reduce el daño que recibe.

items.texto_en:
Ability Hit: +20 (+12 per Level) bonus Magical Damage
Kill or Assist a Minion:
• -2s Cooldown
Cooldown: 15s
items.descripcion_es: Cada 15 s tu habilidad hace daño mágico extra. Se recarga antes si farmeas.

items.texto_en:
On Use: Your next Ability that damages a god Silences them for 1.5s
Cooldown: 70s
items.descripcion_es: Activo: tu siguiente habilidad silencia al rival 1.5 s.

items.texto_en:
On Use: Reveal enemy Gods within 17.6m for 6s.
• Reveal persists through Stealth
• If any God is revealed, +25% Movement Speed for 6s
• First time you damage a revealed God:
• +50 (+50% Strength) Physical Damage
Cooldown: 60s
items.descripcion_es: Activo: revela a los enemigos cercanos (aunque estén invisibles) y te da velocidad y daño.

items.texto_en:
Non-Aspect:
+45 Strength
+15% Attack Speed
Flurry fires out multiple Acorn projectiles that return back at max range, dealing damage and granting Movement Speed. Each enemy god hit provides Attack Speed.
Aspect:
+400 Health
+15 Tenacity
Flurry has 2 charges, Heals and provides Protections.
items.descripcion_es: Bellota de Ratatoskr: mejora su Ráfaga.

items.texto_en:
On Use: +25% Strength and Immune to Displacement for 10s.
Cooldown: 120s
items.descripcion_es: Activo: +25% de Fuerza e inmunidad a empujones por 10 s.

items.texto_en:
Attack hit a God: Debuff that God.
• -3.5% Protections
When Debuffed God Is in Jungle OR Heals 5% of their Health:
• Stacks become twice as effective.
Debuff lasts 4s, Stacks up to 3 times.

items.texto_en:
Gain bonus Intelligence and Lifesteal scaled from missing Health.
• Caps at +60 Intelligence and +10% Lifesteal at 40% Health

Ability Hit: Target gains +1 Stack of Jagged Wounds for 5s (max 3)

Each Stack: +8% (+1% per 10% Lifesteal) Attack and Ability Damage as Physical Damage.

items.texto_en:
When falling below 60% Health: Become Berserk for 8s.
While Berserk:
• +15 of Physical and Magical Protections
• +25% Attack Speed
items.descripcion_es: Bajo 60% de vida: +15 protecciones y +25% de velocidad de ataque por 8 s.

items.texto_en:
On Use: + Health Shield for 6s.
• Shield = 7.5% Max Health & 75% Intelligence from Items
• While Shielded: +10% Lifesteal and 10% Penetration
Kill a God: -25% Cooldown.
Cooldown: 80s

items.texto_en:
On Use: + Health Shield for 6s.
• Shield = 10% Max Health & 150% Strength from Items
• While Shielded: +10% Lifesteal
Kill a God: -25% Cooldown.
Cooldown: 80s
items.descripcion_es: Activo: escudo grande y robo de vida. Se recarga al matar.

+Intelligence equal to 5% of Mana from Items.

+1 Evolve Stack
+1 Mana Infusion Stack (Max 50 Stacks)

• Additional +Intelligence equal to 2% of Mana from Items

• +100 Mana

items.texto_en:
Hit enemy Gods or Jungle Bosses: +8 Attack Damage for 10s.
Stacks up to 8 times.

items.texto_en:
Attack Hit: +10 (+3 per Level) bonus Magical Damage.
Structures and Bosses take half damage from Bragi's Harp

items.texto_en:
Adaptive Stat: +35 Strength or +50 Intelligence (based on highest item stat).
On God Damage Dealt: Apply 40% Healing Reduction for 5s

items.texto_en:
Non-Aspect:
+45 Strength
+8 Pathfinding
Dart becomes wider and passes through enemy gods. Its Cooldown is reset on enemy god hit. It cannot be reset more than twice.

+400 Health
+4 Health Regen
+2 Mana Regen
After hitting an enemy god with Dart, they are knocked back and explode after a delay.

items.texto_en:
+20% Increased Healing and Shielding
Every 15s: Lowest Health ally within 8.8m gain:

• +20 Mana Regen

During Moonlight Phase: On trigger:
• You also gain the Buff

items.texto_en:
On Use:
• Become Polymorphed
• Dash Forward, dealing 50 Physical Damage
• +CC Immune
• +60 Physical and Magical Protection
On Enemy God Hit:
• Knock Up
• Bonus Damage equal to 10% of Current Health
• -40s Cooldown
Cooldown: 120s
items.descripcion_es: Activo: te transformas, embistes, eres inmune a control y levantas al rival.

items.texto_en:
Damaged by an Attack or Ability: Apply +1 Stack of Contagion (1 per hit)
• If an enemy Lifesteals 100 Health from you: Apply +5 Stacks
Attack or Hard Crowd Control an afflicted enemy:
• Deal Magical Damage = 1% Max Health per stack in a 4m radius
• Remove the Stacks

items.texto_en:

items.texto_en:

Non-Healing Ability Use: Consume all Stacks, +10 Strength or +15 Intelligence (based on highest item stat) for 8s per Stack (max 3)

items.texto_en:

• Lose all Intelligence. Gain 66% of it as Strength.
• +25% Crit Chance
Buff lasts 6s.
Cooldown: 45s
+35% Critical Strike Damage.

items.texto_en:
Kill Minion or Jungle Monsters: +1 Stack.

• +.4 Strength
• +0.05% Lifesteal

items.texto_en:

• Mark breaks if ally is more than 20m away

• Grant yourself 1 stack of Devotion.

-30% Shields applied to enemy Gods within 11.2m.

items.texto_en:
Assist a Minion: +1 Stack.
God Kill or Assist: +5 Stacks.

• +100 Max Health
• +10 Physical and Magical Protection
